_doc: BLACKRIDGE achievements (2026-10-14): the single source of truth for the game (core/meta/achievements.js attaches a detector to every slug; core/meta/achievements.selftest.cjs fails if the two sets differ) AND the portal seeder (pipeline/seed_achievements_json.py --game blackridge). Fields are exactly the achievements table's (slug, name, description, tier, points, secret). Tier -> points per migration 0003: bronze 5 / silver 15 / gold 30 / diamond 60. Lifetime counts (kills, headshots, weapons, arenas) are kept per device. PVP text never mentions bots, AI or difficulty.
